Recover your TD-H9

If an update stopped or your radio won’t start, use the steps below to check whether it can still enter USB update mode.

1. Reconnect in USB update mode

If the updater is still writing or verifying, leave the radio on and connected until it finishes or reports an error. If it stopped, keep the original updater tab open and keep the firmware and recovery files you used.

  1. Turn the radio off and plug it directly into your computer with a data-capable USB-C cable.
  2. Hold the side PTT (talk) button and the keypad 2 while turning the radio on. A blank screen and a green top light are normal in this mode.
  3. In the updater, go to Connect in update mode, select Connect radio, and choose JieLi from the device list. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.

If JieLi doesn’t appear, try another data cable or USB port and repeat the steps. Close any other updater tabs or tools that may have claimed the radio. If you still can’t connect, go to Other recovery options.

2. Retry or restore your backup

  • To retry the update, use the same firmware in your original updater tab. If you reconnected, select your original recovery backup under Use a saved restore point, if you have one. Check Skip creating a recovery backup for this install to reuse the original restore point. Read the confirmation and select the install button. The updater checks the radio before it writes.
  • To return to your backup, load the firmware package you originally chose, then select your saved .h9hid or compatible .bin under Use a saved restore point on the Install step. Read the confirmation and select Restore backup or Restore stock v1.0.38, whichever the updater shows. A Bluetooth channel backup won’t work for firmware recovery.

If the updater rejects your backup or you can’t find it, keep the error message and go to Other recovery options. Use the original recovery file from this radio whenever possible.

3. Restart after verification

Wait for the updater to confirm verification and request a restart. If the radio stays in update mode, unplug the USB cable, turn the radio off, then turn it back on without holding any buttons. Check that the channel screen opens and that your saved channels and settings look right.

Other recovery options

  • PTT + 2 works, but browser recovery won’t finish. The command-line tool can restore the main firmware to stock v1.0.38 if you have the verified raw stock restore point. See the desktop stock recovery instructions.
  • PTT + 2 won’t open update mode. On stock or H9 Toolbox Firmware, try holding 8 while turning on the radio with USB connected. If your computer detects BR23 UBOOT1.00, see the desktop BR23 USB flasher instructions for that mode.
  • Neither USB mode appears. If you’ve tried another data cable and USB port, stop here. Recovery over USB requires your computer to detect the radio in one of these modes.
